title: Your Reflection STAYS When You Walk Away
description:
In this town, your reflection stays in the glass after you leave. The fry van's shiny side has a queue a hundred people long, and a puddle on the boards still has a man tying his boot from March.

It's the last night of the travelling fair, and Tasha meets me at the mirror maze, the way she has every night this week.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Which mirror is still holding an old you?
